title: Avoiding a storage renewal charge
titleZh: 避免儲存服務續約扣款

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The design team moved its files to the new storage service last week. Can we close the old account before it renews on Monday?
turns.zh: 設計組上週已把檔案移到新的儲存服務。我們可以在星期一續約前關閉舊帳戶嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not yet. The new service has the files, but it doesn't have the comments our clients added. I can export those by Monday afternoon.
turns.zh: 還不行。新服務已有檔案，但沒有客戶加的留言。我可以最晚在星期一下午把那些留言匯出。

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You don't have to close the account today. Turn off automatic renewal by noon Friday. We'll still have read-only access through Monday, but there won't be another charge.
turns.zh: 今天不用關閉帳戶。最晚星期五中午關掉自動續約即可。我們星期一當天仍可唯讀存取，而且不會再被扣款。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Please send me the export when it's ready. I don't want to close the old account until I've checked that every client comment came through.
turns.zh: 匯出完成後請傳給我。我想等到確認每則客戶留言都保留下來，再關閉舊帳戶。

audioScript:
The design team moved its files to the new storage service last week. Can we close the old account before it renews on Monday?
Not yet. The new service has the files, but it doesn't have the comments our clients added. I can export those by Monday afternoon.
You don't have to close the account today. Turn off automatic renewal by noon Friday. We'll still have read-only access through Monday, but there won't be another charge.
Please send me the export when it's ready. I don't want to close the old account until I've checked that every client comment came through.
